KNOW #7 📚 Risk : Reward
40% win rate pe bhi profit kaise?
• Risk to reward matlab, ek rupaya risk karke kitna kamaane ka target hai.
• 1:2 RR pe har win do losses ko cover karta hai.
• 10 trades, 4 win: 4×2 = +8R, 6 loss = −6R. Net +2R.
Tip: entry se pehle target aur stop dono likho.

KNOW #6 📚 1% Risk Rule
Pro traders ek trade pe kitna risk lete hain?
• Zyaadatar 1 se 2 percent per trade.
• 1% pe lagatar 10 loss bhi ho to account lagbhag 90% bacha rehta hai.
• 10% risk pe wahi 10 loss account ko lagbhag 65% neeche le jaate hain.
Tip: bada profit nahi, lamba survival hi game jitata hai.
